posts.title: Adventures in the Seasonally-Confused Canadian Wilderness
posts.description: Sometimes a person needs to spend time with a good ol’ fashioned movie. The Incredible Journey (1963), from Walt Disney Productions, is such a flick. It’s a ludicrous yarn about three pets who travel 480 km (300 miles) across the Ontario wilderness to their home.
